VERDICT: REJECT

The proposed answer of 5 is probably not the correct bound. The result this problem appears to be based on gives a Hausdorff codimension bound of 4 for the singular set of stable stationary harmonic maps into such groups, not 5. The excluded groups (Sp(n) for n ≥ 8, E₈, F₄, G₂) are the cases where stable harmonic spheres with low-dimensional singularities can occur, which would weaken the bound. The solution also gives no justification for the claimed uniform bound of 5, and its sharpness argument is asserted rather than shown. Generic stable harmonic maps only give codimension 3 or 4 bounds, so a uniform bound of 5 for all stable maps with the stated targets is doubtful. I have not checked the literature directly, so this rests on my recollection of the result.

CONFIDENCE: 2
